title: Procedure tools for story work: save a story version, link a reference, read a story's editorial context
description: execute_tactus exposes reads, Assignment/Reference/MessageThread resources and reference notes, but not the story operations an analysis procedure needs: create a story, save a version with front matter and body (what papyrus stories save-version does), link a reference as consulted or cited, and move stage. Add them to the papyrus host module with the same rules the CLI applies.
